snippet.title: The Subminer Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description: The Subminer is an underwater survival exploration game set in an alien ocean beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Mine your way through a breakable environment while being aware of your surroundings. You never know what dangers are watching you from the shadows. Manage your resources carefully while you are underwater. One small miscalculation could mean death. Progress through a procedurally generated ocean spanning 3 depth levels, each filled with its own secrets, traps and monsters. Death is not the end. Upgrade your toolkit at the end of every run to go a little further each time.
